title: Dynamism under the hood: Coevolutionary maintenance of variation in hosts and parasites
content:
by Andrea L. Graham, David A. Chang van Oordt

Why do hosts and parasites vary so much? A new study in PLOS Biology reveals that infection outcomes strongly depend upon interacting effects of host and parasite genotypes, offering an evolutionary explanation for profound and persistent variability.
